name: S.Y.K ~Renshouden~
source:
This is a fan disc of S.Y.K -Shinsetsu Saiyuki-. You can enjoy sweeter love stories with target characters and past stories, which were previously untold.

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
本作是《S.Y.K～新说西游记～》的Fan Disc。玩家可以欣赏与攻略角色之间更加甜蜜的爱情故事，以及此前从未讲述的往事。

[摘自Himeya Shop]
